program.title: BSc in Biotechnology and Business
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-6, 0-3, 3-4).
Students taking the program as first major are exempted from the School Requirements (see PDF preamble).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. BIBU 4840/4850, LIFS 1901 exemption, CHEM 1008 exemption, MATH block, PHYS block, ECON 2103/2113), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.

The elective list also allows 'Any LIFS courses at 3000/4000-level' (Biotechnology area) and 'Any ECON/FINA/ISOM/MARK/MGMT courses at 3000/4000-level' (Business area), so the recorded elective course list is not exhaustive.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 BIBU (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
